doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]

title: What is swing?
summary: Gibbs jokes that swing is anything that makes you tap your foot.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Yeah. Okay, so let’s suppose you sat on a panel of highly educated music scholars, and you being the jazz representative are asked the question, “What is swing?”

I’d say you’re all a bunch of idiots. What kind of question? What is swing? Anything that makes you tap your foot I suppose would be swing music and that’s — you know bebop was swing music, make you tap your foot. Any kind of music that makes you tap your foot. That’s the only way I can really put that thing into any kind of sense you know. Heck if it makes you drink, it makes you swing it. You know?
